verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth's core purpose is generating TOTP (and HOTP/Steam Guard) codes on mobile and browser extension, and docs reference guided setup via video tutorials for connecting accounts, implying QR-scan onboarding. However, no evidence explicitly describes the QR-code scanning step itself or confirms immediacy of code generation post-scan. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshots of the QR-scan-to-add-account flow, independent/hands-on confirmation that scanning works smoothly, and clarity on any friction in that specific first-run experience.
